chunks: The day the sky becomes like molten brass,
ai.seo_question: What does the sky look like on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Ma'arij?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Surah Al-Ma'arij 70:8) highlights the fragility of the created order, emphasizing that the heavens' stability is contingent upon divine will. The imagery of 'molten metal' (al-muhl) signifies not just physical dissolution but the removal of the veils that conceal divine truth, preparing the stage for the final reckoning. This cosmic transformation serves as a powerful reminder for believers to maintain spiritual vigilance amidst worldly stability.
